compute_nonstationary_kernel: compute the nonstationary kernel Q and C values from two sets of coordinates and covariance matrices
compute_prob_product_kernel: compute the probability product quadratic form and constant for two covariance matrices
compute_gaussian_convolution: compute the convolution of heterogeneous Gaussian kernels on R2 from coordinates and covariance matrices
compute_squared_exponential_kernel: compute the squared exponential isotropic covariance kernel from a quadratic form tensor
compute_matern_kernel: compute the Matern v=3/2 isotropic covariance kernel from a quadratic form tensor
